svg.aria-label: Ten new eCourts app icon designs in light and dark
svg.text: Ten geometric marks · light and dark

svg.title: eCourts — Civic — light
svg.desc: Full-bleed light app icon. A custom e with an open circular silhouette. Independently editable silhouette, colour and surface layers. Original native vector artwork without raster images, fonts or external resources.

svg.title: eCourts — Civic — dark
svg.desc: Full-bleed dark app icon. A custom e with an open circular silhouette. Independently editable silhouette, colour and surface layers. Original native vector artwork without raster images, fonts or external resources.

svg.title: eCourts — Parity — light
svg.desc: Full-bleed light app icon. Two equal bars with opposing diagonal cuts. Independently editable silhouette, colour and surface layers. Original native vector artwork without raster images, fonts or external resources.

svg.title: eCourts — Parity — dark
svg.desc: Full-bleed dark app icon. Two equal bars with opposing diagonal cuts. Independently editable silhouette, colour and surface layers. Original native vector artwork without raster images, fonts or external resources.

svg.title: eCourts — Folio — light

svg.title: eCourts — Folio — dark

svg.title: eCourts — Forum — light

svg.title: eCourts — Forum — dark

svg.title: eCourts — Docket — dark
